collocations: interior décor：室内装饰风格
the restaurant’s elegant new décor：餐馆内部别致的新装潢
words.definition: （建筑内部的）装饰布局，装饰风格
words.etymology: 1897, “scenery and furnishings,” from French décor (18c.), back-formation from décorer “to decorate” (14c.), from Latin decorare “to decorate, adorn, embellish, beautify,” from decus (genitive decoris) “an ornament”. The modern word thus duplicates Latin decor “beauty, elegance, charm, grace, 20000 词汇巅峰 速 记 笔 记 区 ornament.”
words.mnemonic: dec-（装饰）+ -or（名词后缀）→用来指装饰风格

words.definition: 装饰；点缀；授给（某人）勋章（或奖章） vt.&vi.
examples:
They decorated the room with flowers and balloons.
他们用花和气球装饰了房间。
Then they decorate it with old style furniture.
然后，他们用旧家具来装饰它。
words.mnemonic: decor（=ornament：装饰）+ -ate（动词后缀）→装饰，装潢；粉刷；

examples:
I did a lot of the decorating myself.
我自己干了很多装修的活儿。
words.mnemonic: decorate（装饰）+ -ing（名词后缀）→装饰；装修

paper decorations：彩纸饰品

words.mnemonic: decor（装饰）+ -ation（复合名词后缀）→装饰；装饰品

examples: for purely decorative purposes：纯粹用于装饰目的
words.mnemonic: decor（装饰）+ -ative（复合形容词后缀）→装饰的

examples:
The walls were adorned with paintings.

examples:

collocations: preserve dignity：保持尊严
die with dignity：死得有尊严
the dignity of work：工作的尊贵

words.definition: 尊贵，高贵；庄重，尊严；自尊
words.etymology: c. 1200, “state of being worthy,” from Old French dignite “dignity, privilege, honor,” from Latin dignitatem (nominative dignitas) “worthiness,” from dignus “worth (n.), worthy, proper, fitting,” from PIE *dek-no-, suffixed form of root *dek- “to take, accept.”
words.mnemonic:
dign-（=worthy, proper, fitting：值得尊敬的；得体的，体面的）+ -ity
（名词后缀）→尊贵；尊严；自尊，自重

collocations: suffer the indignity of：蒙受……的羞辱
the daily indignities of imprisonment：身陷囹圄每日所带来的侮辱
words.definition: 侮辱；轻蔑；侮辱性的行为 [of sth./of doing sth.]
words.mnemonic: in-（表翻译）+ dignity（尊贵；尊严）→使……没有尊严→引申词义

collocations: a dignified person/manner/voice：有尊严的人；庄重的举止；庄严的声音
words.definition: 有尊严的，高贵的；庄重的，庄严的
words.mnemonic:
dign-（=dignity：尊严；高贵；庄重）+i + -fy（使动词后缀，变y为
i）+ -ed（形容词后缀）→有尊严的，高贵的；庄重的

collocations: entertain visiting dignitaries：招待来访要员
words.definition: 显贵；（政府或教会的）显要人物
words.mnemonic: dignity（尊贵）+ -ary（名词后缀，表人）→尊贵的人→引申义显

collocations: to be full of righteous indignation：义愤填膺
examples: The rise in train fares has aroused public indignation.
words.mnemonic:
in-（表否定）+ dign-（=dignity：尊贵；高贵）+ -ation（复合名词后
缀）→没有（受到）尊贵（礼遇）→愤怒；愤慨；义愤

collocations: an indignant letter/look：愤慨的信/神情
be indignant about sth.：对……很愤慨
examples:
我们中国人都有节俭的好传统，对任何形式的浪费都感到愤慨。
We Chinese people have the good tradition of being economical, and are
indignant about waste of any kind.
words.mnemonic: indign（in-+ dign-：没有收到尊贵礼遇）+ -ant（形容词后缀）→愤怒
